description: This file defines internal heap APIs and data structures for memory management, including chunk handling, heap structure, and utility functions for heap operations.

methods.name: big_heap_chunks
methods.description: Determines if the heap is considered a big heap based on chunk size.

methods.name: big_heap_bytes
methods.description: Checks if the heap size in bytes qualifies as a big heap.

methods.name: big_heap
methods.description: Determines if the heap instance is a big heap.

methods.name: chunk_buf
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer representing the heap's chunks.

methods.name: chunk_field
methods.description: Accesses a specific field of a chunk in the heap.

methods.name: chunk_set
methods.description: Sets a specific field of a chunk in the heap.

methods.name: chunk_used
methods.description: Checks if a chunk is marked as used.

methods.name: chunk_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a chunk.

methods.name: set_chunk_used
methods.description: Marks a chunk as used or free.

methods.name: set_chunk_size
methods.description: Sets the size of a chunk.

methods.name: prev_free_chunk
methods.description: Gets the previous free chunk in the free list.

methods.name: next_free_chunk
methods.description: Gets the next free chunk in the free list.

methods.name: set_prev_free_chunk
methods.description: Sets the previous free chunk in the free list.

methods.name: set_next_free_chunk
methods.description: Sets the next free chunk in the free list.

methods.name: left_chunk
methods.description: Returns the neighboring chunk to the left.

methods.name: right_chunk
methods.description: Returns the neighboring chunk to the right.

methods.name: set_left_chunk_size
methods.description: Sets the size of the left neighbor chunk.

methods.name: solo_free_header
methods.description: Checks if a free header is solitary.

methods.name: chunk_header_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a chunk header.

methods.name: heap_footer_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of heap footer.

methods.name: chunksz
methods.description: Calculates the number of chunks needed for a given byte size.

methods.name: bytes_to_chunksz
methods.description: Converts bytes to chunk units considering header size.

methods.name: min_chunk_size
methods.description: Returns the minimum chunk size.

methods.name: chunksz_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts chunk units back to bytes.

methods.name: bucket_idx
methods.description: Calculates the bucket index for a given chunk size.

methods.name: size_too_big
methods.description: Checks if a size in bytes exceeds heap capacity.

methods.name: get_alloc_info
methods.description: Retrieves total allocated and free bytes in the heap.
